title: 第130章 师弟不会死了吧第129章 此妖不可杀
content_zh:
第一卷第130章师弟不会死了吧……
太穹峰上空弥漫着压抑的气息。
湖畔凉亭中，关酒、上官月、媱鹊和霜萦围坐在木桌旁。
桌上放着一副牌，却是整整齐齐码在一起，没有使用过的痕迹。
四个人表情都有些沉重，视线齐齐落在不远处闭眼打坐、偶尔抬头看一眼天际的蓝裙女子身上。
距离飞仙门遭劫，已过了半个月。
飞仙门各处皆已完成重建，恢复了本来的面貌。
只是这次大劫死的有点多，杂役、外门弟子死的死逃的逃，所剩不足百人，内门弟子也损了近四成。
飞仙门高层已召开数次峰主大会，商议是否需要招收新弟子，以及大咫峰的归属问题。
最后都是不了了之，没商议出个结果。
自飞仙门劫难过去，栾清萍就一直坐在那个位置，似乎对一切都失去了兴趣，只顾打坐修行。
关酒悠悠叹息，“清萍再这样下去，怕是会走火入魔的吧……”
其他几人并未接话，都有些心不在焉。
良久，霜萦道：“听你们说，她与天寿道友好不容易有了进展，却发生这样的事，如今连天寿道友在哪儿，是死是活都不知道，这般表现也是正常，只能等她自己走出来了。”
半月前飞仙门就已派人去万灵宗，告知飞仙门遭劫之事。
算算时日，接应他们的人，应该也快到了。
万灵宗弟子在这场劫难中，死了得有六成，活下来的也或多或少有些损伤。
霜萦此时的心情也颇为复杂。
上官月才得知陈玄与栾清萍之事不久，刚知道这个消息的时候，她心中莫名有些酸涩，但看到栾清萍此时的表现，她突然觉得，或许也只有栾师姐这样的人，才能配得上陈师兄吧……
“栾师姐心中应该很难受吧，连牌都不愿意碰了，也不知道天寿师兄去哪儿了。”

上官月靠在椅子上，脑海中浮现那个少年和熙的笑颜。
紫凝上人最近一直忙于门内之事，也是无暇顾及栾清萍，她们几个换着花样劝导栾，也没什么用。
栾清萍一直说自己没事，表现得也很平静，似乎并未太过担心陈玄。
但就是因为她表现的太过平静，反而让几人觉得不正常。
关酒掌起酒葫芦喝了口，“听师兄说，掌门知晓天寿的行踪，但却是半个字都不愿透露，只说让我们不要担心，说什么天寿很快就会回来……”
“这都半个月了，没有半点关于他的消息，再这样下去，飞仙门弟子都不记得他这号人存在了，怎么能不让人担心的嘛！”
说着，她突然一拍桌子站起来，“不行，我去找掌门问个清楚，清萍怎么说也是他的弟子，再这样下去，这弟子可要废掉了！”
关酒站起身来，走出凉亭，唤出飞剑离开了太穹峰。
其余三人并未阻拦。
凉亭中陷入沉默。
上官月看着小湖发呆。
霜萦望着栾清萍的背影，心中感慨万千。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 130 Junior brother will not die...
An oppressive atmosphere filled the sky above Taiqiong Peak.
In the pavilion by the lake, Guan Jiu, Shangguan Yue, Que Que and Shuang Ying sat around the wooden table.
There is a deck of cards on the table, but they are stacked neatly together, with no trace of use.
The expressions of the four people were a little heavy, and their eyes all fell on the woman in a blue dress not far away who was meditating with her eyes closed and occasionally looked up at the sky.
It has been half a month since Feixianmen was robbed.
All parts of Feixianmen have been rebuilt and restored to their original appearance.
It's just that there were a lot of deaths in this catastrophe. The servants and outer disciples fled to death, leaving less than a hundred people left, and nearly 40% of the inner disciples were lost.
The top leaders of Feixianmen have held several peak master meetings to discuss whether it is necessary to recruit new disciples and the ownership of the Great Peak.
In the end, it was all settled and no result was reached through negotiation.
Since the Feixianmen disaster passed, Luan Qingping has been sitting in that position, seeming to have lost interest in everything and just meditating.
Guan Jiu sighed, "Qingping will go crazy if she continues like this..."
The other people didn't answer, they were all a little absent-minded.
After a long time, Shuang Ying said: "I heard from you that her friendship with Taoist Tianshou has not been easy to make progress, but something like this happened. Now she doesn't even know where Taoist Tianshou is, whether she is dead or alive. Such behavior is normal. We can only wait for her to come out on her own."
Half a month ago, Feixianmen sent people to Wanling Sect to inform Feixianmen about the robbery.
Counting the time, the person who will take care of them should be arriving soon.
Sixty percent of the disciples of Wanling Sect died in this disaster, and those who survived were more or less injured.
Shuangying's mood at this time was also quite complicated.
Shangguan Yue had just learned about the affair between Chen Xuan and Luan Qingping not long ago. When she first learned the news, she felt a little sour in her heart. But seeing Luan Qingping's behavior at this time, she suddenly felt that maybe only someone like Senior Sister Luan could be worthy of Senior Brother Chen...
"Senior Sister Luan must be feeling very sad. She doesn't even want to touch the cards anymore. I don't know where Senior Brother Tianshou has gone."
Shangguan Yue leaned back on the chair, and the smile of the young man He Xi appeared in his mind.
Master Zi Ning has been busy with internal matters recently and has no time to take care of Luan Qingping. They tried different tricks to persuade Luan, but it was of no use.
Luan Qingping kept saying that she was fine and acted very calmly. She didn't seem too worried about Chen Xuan.
But just because she acted too calmly, it made a few people feel that it was abnormal.
Guan Jiu picked up the wine gourd and took a sip, "I heard from senior brother that the master knew Tianshou's whereabouts, but he didn't want to reveal a word. He only told us not to worry, saying that Tianshou would be back soon..."
"It's been half a month, and there's no news about him. If this continues, the disciples of the Feixian Sect won't even remember that he exists. How can we not make people worried!"
As she said that, she suddenly slapped the table and stood up, "No, I'll go find the master and ask him clearly. Qingping is also his disciple. If this continues, this disciple will be ruined!"
Guan Jiu stood up, walked out of the pavilion, summoned the flying sword and left Taiqiong Peak.
The other three did not stop him.
Silence fell in the pavilion.
Shangguan Yue looked at the small lake in a daze.
Shuangying looked at Luan Qingping's back, feeling filled with emotion.
